links.comparator_used: Original ChatGPT-4o responses to the same five questions, before the 'explain in simpler terms' prompt modification (one fixed output)
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of responses before vs after simplification prompt
links.effect: Mean FKGL fell to 4.9 and mean FRE rose to 79.0, versus baseline English responses with mean FKGL 10.5, GFI 11.1 and FRE 37.8 (college-level literacy); content reported as unaltered
links.quote: Prompting simplification improved readability significantly (mean FKGL: 4.9; FRE: 79.0), without altering content.
